Initial release of quant-tools: a comprehensive academic-oriented quantitative research toolkit.

- Includes 7 core research libraries (factor analysis, portfolio optimization, AI enhancement, causal inference, derivatives pricing, backtesting engine, sentiment analysis).
- Bundles 5 major investment research tools: VeighNa trading framework, Qlib AI research, WTP high-performance engine, AkShare data interface, JupyterHub research environment.
- Supports strategy development, factor mining, academic replication, asset allocation, and API service tasks.
- Ideal for quant research teams seeking an integrated toolchain for both algorithmic innovation and investment research.
- Trigger words: 量化、quant、因子、组合优化、因子分析、回测、交易框架、数据接口、学术研究.
